theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ) {ι : Type} (l : Filter ι) (t : ι → ℝ), x ∈ U → Tendsto t l (𝓝[>] 0) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(rescaledMeasure V x (t i))) l (𝓝 (θ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure T)))) → ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → Tendsto (fun i ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x (t i) ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / t i ^ n) l (𝓝 (θ * (unitBallVolume n).toReal * β T))
